Earning this item also unlocks a unique [[Ad Infinitum (glider)|glider skin]]. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|Log 18204: Losing transmissionsomething went wrongI'mstranded_. I'm stuck in[[Fractal]]. Floating. The whole island isfloating. Call themselves[[Forgotten|Forgotten]]. Trees. I seesomeone_? Can you hearme?}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Unbound | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of Infinity | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Fortune | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Ascension }} == Collections == Obtaining the precursor, [[Unbound]], requires players to complete the three Ad Infinitum I - III collections. The fourth collection, [[Legendary Backpack: Ad Infinitum]], will allow the creation of the legendary Ad Infinitum. These four collections will be primarily focused on the [[Fractals of the Mists]] where players will be presented with challenges to complete and items to collect on their journey for the [[legendary back item]]. Several items needed in the collection process require any [[expansion]] unlocked, as the ability to purchase these items is locked behind the [[Central Tyria mastery tracks#Fractal Attunement|Fractal Attunement]] [[mastery]]. * {{achievement|Ad Infinitum I: Finite Result}} * {{achievement|Ad Infinitum II: Upper Bound}} * {{achievement|Ad Infinitum III: Unbound}} * {{achievement|Legendary Backpack: Ad Infinitum}} The four collections can be expanded in full detail below, for ease of tracking.

Component materials |- | rowspan="4" | {{item icon|Unbound}} |{{item icon|Solution: Unbound}} | : Achievement reward: [[Ad Infinitum III: Unbound]] |- | {{item icon|Pristine Mist Essence}} x5 | : {{item icon|Rare Essence of Luck}} x50 : {{item icon|Cube of Stabilized Dark Energy}} x5 : {{item icon|Thermocatalytic Reagent}} x50 |- |{{item icon|Unbound Wings}} | : {{item icon|Glob of Ectoplasm}} x25 : {{item icon|Shard of Crystallized Mists Essence}} x5 : {{item icon|Vision Crystal}} : {{item icon|Spirit of the Upper Bound}} (Salvaged from [[Upper Bound]]) |- class="line" |{{item icon|Third Order Mist Frame}} | : {{item icon|Spiritwood Plank}} x5 : {{item icon|Deldrimor Steel Ingot}} x5 : {{item icon|Elonian Leather Square}} x5 : {{item icon|Bolt of Damask}} x5 |- | rowspan="4" |{{item icon|Gift of Fortune}} |{{item icon|Glob of Ectoplasm}} x250 | |- |{{item icon|Mystic Clover}} x77 | {{Mystic Clover acquisition|77|list=legacyforge}} |- |{{item icon|Gift of Magic}} | : 250 {{item icon|Vial of Powerful Blood|Vials of Powerful Blood}} : 250 {{item icon|Powerful Venom Sac}}s : 250 {{item icon|Elaborate Totem}}s : 250 {{item icon|Pile of Crystalline Dust|Piles of Crystalline Dust}} |- |{{item icon|Gift of Might}} | : 250 {{item icon|Vicious Fang}}s : 250 {{item icon|Armored Scale}}s : 250 {{item icon|Vicious Claw}}s : 250 {{item icon|Ancient Bone}}s |- | rowspan="1" | {{item icon|Gift of Infinity}} | colspan="2" | Achievement reward: [[Legendary Backpack: Ad Infinitum]] |- | rowspan="1" | {{item icon|Gift of Ascension}} | colspan="2" | Purchased with {{currency|500|Fractal Relic}} + {{currency|2520|coin}} |} == Effects == * When the player's weapon is drawn, an explosion of light particles emanate from the backpiece, followed by a steady glow behind the player's head. The backpiece itself expands in size, "flaring" out with an increased span. * The glow disappears in favor of a transparent [[ley line]] glow when the player's weapon is stowed. Ad Infinitum drawn effect.gif|The light particles when weapons are drawn. == Notes == * It requires 4 [[Fractal Journal]]s, each taking 4-5 days to get in the most optimal case (see [[Fractal Journal]]). * Its infusion slots can be swapped without an [[Infusion Extraction Device]]. The swapped infusion appears in the player's inventory. == Available prefixes == * The following [[Attribute combinations|prefixes]] can be selected: {{prefix selection|all legendary trinket}} == Trivia == * [[w:Ad infinitum|Ad infinitum]] is a [[w:Latin|Latin]] phrase meaning "to infinity". * The precursor, [[Unbound]], was available to craft since the launch of [[Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns]], though the ability to actually create the legendary back piece was not available until [[Game updates/2016-04-19#Ad_Infinitum|April 19, 2016]]. * The names given to the precursors seem to be referencing a mathematical function's value progressively growing. [[Finite Result]] being a result of a convergent function, a single numeral value, [[Upper Bound]] being the highest possible value for a function diverging between certain values (bounds), [[Unbound]] suggesting the function exceeding those bounds, breaking out of them and finally [[Ad Infinitum]] meaning "to infinity", suggesting the growth never stops. == See also == * [[Ad Infinitum (glider)|Ad Infinitum Glider]] * [[Legendary Backpacks]] - all 4 collection achievements together for easy reference {{Fractal backpieces nav}} [[Category:Legendary back items]] [[de:Ad Infinitum]] [[es:Ad Infinitum]] [[fr:Ad Infinitum]]
